behaviors.description: Inspect permissions, remote metadata and commit parent.
behaviors.preconditions: Reference-exported queries fixture metadata and A/B ancestry.
behaviors.expected: Network permission, exact reference metadata and independently known A parent.

behaviors.description: Select installed architecture in list and info.
behaviors.preconditions: Both native and foreign copies installed.
behaviors.expected: Lists exclude competing architecture; info selects exact foreign commit.

behaviors.description: Query installed metadata, origin, runtime and typed ref lists.
behaviors.expected: Exact fixture metadata and selected refs.

behaviors.description: Query path access before and after filesystem grants.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed app with no host filesystem grant.

mappings.rationale: Reference-generated metadata and parent commit provide independent oracles.

surface_assertions.rationale: Exact output is the fixture network Context, not general info or full metadata.
Output equals independently reference-exported metadata file.
Output equals exact A parent of reference-generated B commit.

mappings.rationale: Exact selected installed foreign full ref and commit.

surface_assertions.rationale: With both copies installed, architecture-free info selects foreign copy over native.
Native and foreign list queries each exclude the other installed copy.

mappings.rationale: Exact app/runtime metadata sections and fields and full ref/commit queries match fixture.

surface_assertions.rationale: Installed origin equals configured fixture remote.
SDK query returns exact SDK declared by fixture metadata.
Ref-only queries return exact expected refs.
